title: Augmi
tagline: Platform for creating AI Influencers and monetizing their content on World App.
description: We make it easy for you to create and monetize your AI influencers. Create your influencer inside the app. Then use the post prompt writer assistant to do web research and write prompts for you, select the one you want, and the post and AI content generation model.  Your audience can connect and bond with the AI through one on one chats. All of the tips that are sent to the AI are sent directly to the owner of the AI. Human verification is required to prevent AI's from benefiting from the platform and spamming.
how_its_made: World mini app with ability to send WLD tokens and verify humanity. We used nextjs, prisma SQL database, and API services: Tavily for web search, Together AI for Llama 3.3, Flux and Kontext image generation models. We store images the user uploads on AWS S3. The prompt generator assistant uses the AI character details to generate a search query, then it's gathers current news and web content on the topic, then it uses that to generate a list of possible prompts the user can use. We use the kontext image generation model to create character consistent images for the post.
